hero.subtitle: Empowering Ethiopians with affordable and accessible healthcare. A community solidarity program ensuring secure, digital medical coverage for every household.

executive_hero.official_portal: Federal Ministry of Health • Official CBHI Portal
executive_hero.subtitle: Community-Based Health Insurance guarantees comprehensive inpatient, outpatient, and maternal medical care across 3,500+ public and partner health centers nationwide.

citizen_services.title: Citizen Quick Services Hub
citizen_services.subtitle: Instant self-service tools for Ethiopian households to verify coverage, locate health centers, and pay annual premiums.

eligibility_tab.title: Verify Your Household Coverage Status
eligibility_tab.subtitle: Enter your 16-digit Fayda National ID number or Kebele CBHI membership card number to check active coverage.
eligibility_tab.result_desc: ✓ Eligible for free services at all public clinics and contracted tertiary referral hospitals.

facilities_tab.title: Contracted Public & Referral Facilities
facilities_tab.subtitle: Over 3,500 facilities accept CBHI cards across Ethiopia.

payment_tab.title: Seamless Digital Payment Integrations
payment_tab.subtitle: Pay your annual household premium without standing in long queues.
payment_tab.telebirr_desc: Open Telebirr > Services > Government Payments > CBHI > Enter Woreda Code.
payment_tab.cbe_desc: CBE Birr or direct bank branch deposit to your regional CBHI pooled account.
payment_tab.siinqee_desc: Dedicated teller desks across all regional branch locations.

emergency_tab.hotline_desc: If a contracted health center refuses services or demands unauthorized co-payments, call our free toll-free citizen rights desk immediately:
emergency_tab.entitlement_1: Zero fees for outpatient consultations and essential diagnostic laboratory tests.
emergency_tab.entitlement_2: Full inpatient accommodation, surgical care, and intensive care bed fees.
emergency_tab.entitlement_3: Essential medication dispensed directly through hospital or Kenema pharmacies.

community_stories.title: Real Stories of Healthcare Protection
community_stories.subtitle: How Community-Based Health Insurance protects millions of Ethiopian households against catastrophic out-of-pocket medical debts.
community_stories.difference_title: The Difference CBHI Makes for Ethiopian Families
community_stories.without_cbhi_1: Families delay medical care due to fear of unpredictable expenses.
community_stories.without_cbhi_2: Emergency hospitalizations often cause distress asset and livestock sales.
community_stories.without_cbhi_3: Chronic diseases lead to ongoing debt cycles and missed treatments.
community_stories.with_cbhi_1: Early diagnosis and checkups at local Kebele clinics at zero point-of-care cost.
community_stories.with_cbhi_2: Full catastrophic surgery and referral hospitalization covered by the pool.
community_stories.with_cbhi_3: Household savings and peace of mind secured through community solidarity.

stories.name: Almaz Tefera & Family
stories.quote: When my youngest child required emergency appendectomy surgery, the hospital bill would have forced us to sell our farmland. With CBHI, everything was covered 100% with zero out-of-pocket costs.

stories.name: Mulugeta Assefa
stories.quote: For diabetic management and hypertension medicines, monthly pharmacy expenses were unbearable. CBHI allows me to refill prescriptions every month at Kenema Pharmacy with dignity.

stories.name: Fatuma Kedir
stories.quote: Safe hospital delivery and neonatal checkups for my twins were completely stress-free. The midwives and doctors treated us with royal care.

health_rights.description: CBHI Ethiopia was founded on the belief that quality healthcare should never depend on financial status. Through community solidarity, we pool resources so every family, regardless of income, can access essential medical services.

equitable.title: Equitable Access
equitable.description: Ensuring every citizen, regardless of income, can access quality medical care when they need it most.

solidarity.title: Solidarity
solidarity.description: Communities coming together to protect each other from the financial shocks of illness.

coverage.description: From primary health centers to specialized surgery, CBHI covers what matters most.

primary.title: Primary Care
primary.description: Free consultations, check-ups, and basic treatments at any partner clinic.

hospitalization.title: Hospitalization
hospitalization.description: Full inpatient coverage including surgery, ICU, and essential post-care services.

maternal.title: Maternal & Child
maternal.description: Pre-natal, delivery, pediatric and postnatal care fully covered for every family.

enrollment.subtitle: Joining CBHI is simple. Follow these three steps at your local Woreda office and get covered the same day.

step1.title: Identity Check
step1.description: Register at your local Woreda with your Fayda ID. Our system integrates instantly for verification.
step1.badge: Bring your Fayda ID or national ID

step2.title: Annual Contribution
step2.description: Pay a small annual fee based on your household size. Flexible payment options available.

step3.title: Get Coverage
step3.description: Access healthcare instantly at any partner facility with your digital or physical CBHI card.

impact.subtitle: Measurable outcomes driving universal healthcare transformation across the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia.
